parameters.query:
=SELECT
  u.user_id,
  u.name,
  u.email AS csv_email,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY u.user_id) AS user_seq,
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'match_id', m.match_id,
      'product_id', p.id,
      'lender_name', p.lender_name,
      'product_name', p.product_name,
      'interest_rate_min', p.interest_rate_min,
      'interest_rate_max', p.interest_rate_max,
      'loan_amount_min', p.loan_amount_min,
      'loan_amount_max', p.loan_amount_max,
      'source_url', p.source_url,
      'score', m.score,
      'reason', m.reason
    )
    ORDER BY p.interest_rate_min ASC NULLS LAST
  ) AS matched_products
FROM users u
JOIN matches m ON u.user_id = m.user_id
JOIN loan_products p ON m.product_id = p.id
WHERE u.batch_id = '{{ $json.body.batch_id }}'::uuid
  AND m.notification_status = 'pending'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name, u.email
ORDER BY u.user_id
LIMIT 50;

=UPDATE matches SET notification_status = 'sent' WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.user_id || $('Build Emails & Test Aliases').item.json.user_id }}';
SELECT 1;

=UPDATE upload_batches
SET
  emails_sent = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM matches m WHERE m.notification_status = 'sent' AND m.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE batch_id = '{{ $('Webhook Trigger (loan-notify)').first().json.body.batch_id }}'::uuid)),
  status = 'completed',
  completed_at = NOW()
WHERE batch_id = '{{ $('Webhook Trigger (loan-notify)').first().json.body.batch_id }}'::uuid;
